faculty.name: Brian Albanese
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of anxiety and suicide risk using event-related potentials and ecological momentary assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用事件相关电位和生态时刻评估研究焦虑和自杀风险的认知神经机制。

faculty.name: Gerianne Alexander
faculty.summary: Studies the development of human sex differences in social and cognitive behavior, focusing on hormonal influences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类性别差异在社会和认知行为的发展，关注激素的影响。

faculty.name: Brian Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies how learning changes attentional control, using psychophysics and neuroimaging to explore distraction, habit learning, and drug addiction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习如何改变注意力控制，使用心理物理学和神经成像方法探索分心、习惯学习和药物成瘾。

faculty.name: Winfred Arthur
faculty.summary: Studies personnel psychology, focusing on testing, assessment, and validation of selection methods, as well as individual and team training for complex skill acquisition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人事心理学，侧重于选拔方法的测试、评估和验证，以及复杂技能获取和保留的个体与团队培训。

faculty.name: Mayson Astle
faculty.summary: Studies self, choice, and memory in social contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我、选择和记忆在社会中的作用。

faculty.name: Bisi Atoba
faculty.summary: Studies employee well-being and optimal organizational performance through work teams, leadership, and training.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究员工福祉和组织绩效优化，通过工作团队、领导力和培训。

faculty.name: Mindy Bergman
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of organizational climate on workplace behaviors and individual well-being, focusing on diversity and safety.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织气候对工作行为和个体福祉的影响，重点关注多样性和安全。

faculty.name: Jessica Bernard
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive and motor behavior changes with age, focusing on mild cognitive impairment and the cerebellum.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究随年龄变化的认知和运动行为，重点关注轻度认知障碍和小脑。

faculty.name: Carlos Bolaños
faculty.summary: Investigates how early-life exposure to drugs and stress alters brain biochemistry and behavior, affecting mood and motivation later in life.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活经历对药物和压力暴露如何改变大脑生物化学和行为的影响，特别是在情绪和动机方面的长期效应。

faculty.name: Angeline Bottera
faculty.summary: Studies eating disorders, focusing on binge eating and circadian rhythms, using mHealth approaches and clinical trials.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究进食障碍，特别是暴食行为和昼夜节律，采用移动健康技术和临床试验方法。

faculty.name: Rebecca Brooker
faculty.summary: Studies emotional and biological risk factors for anxiety in early life, using neurodevelopmental and gene-environment interaction approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活中的情绪和生物风险因素对焦虑的影响，采用神经发展和基因-环境交互作用的方法。

faculty.name: Ivette Calles-Ramirez
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms involved in learning and memory, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的认知过程和脑机制，使用行为和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Yifeng Cheng
faculty.summary: Studies how brain regions communicate to support flexible decision-making and learning, using behavioral tasks and neural recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑区域如何交流以支持灵活的决策和学习，使用行为任务和神经记录方法。

faculty.name: Pamela Stanush Edens
faculty.summary: Teaches courses in psychology, focusing on human sexuality, organizational psychology, and career guidance.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授心理学课程，包括性心理学、组织心理学和职业指导。

faculty.name: John Edens
faculty.summary: Studies the assessment and management of violence risk, particularly in forensic and correctional settings, focusing on psychopathy and personality measurement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究犯罪和矫正环境中暴力风险的评估与管理，特别是心理病态和人格测量。

faculty.name: Megan Edwards
faculty.summary: Studies the role of hope and awe in promoting human flourishing and meaning in life, especially after adversity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究希望和敬畏在促进人类繁荣和生活意义中的作用，尤其是在经历逆境之后。

faculty.name: Shoshana Eitan
faculty.summary: Studies the biological mechanisms of mental and neurological disorders, focusing on dietary and microbial modulators for depression, anxiety, and Parkinson’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神和神经疾病的基本机制，重点关注饮食和微生物调节剂对抑郁症、焦虑症和帕金森病的影响。

faculty.name: Sherecce Fields
faculty.summary: Studies behavioral decision-making, impulsivity, and its role in health risk behaviors and addictive behaviors in children and adolescents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为决策、冲动性及其在健康风险行为和青少年成瘾行为中的作用。

faculty.name: Leland Fleming
faculty.summary: Studies how psychological stress and early-life trauma affect brain development and aging using neuroimaging and epigenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理压力和早期生活创伤如何影响大脑发展和衰老，使用神经成像和表观遗传学方法。

faculty.name: James Grau
faculty.summary: Studies how the spinal cord can learn and recover function after injury, focusing on pain modulation and neural plasticity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脊髓在损伤后的学习和功能恢复机制，重点关注疼痛调节和神经可塑性。

faculty.name: Joshua Hicks
faculty.summary: Studies how people find meaning in life and how this influences their attitudes and behaviors, using hypotheses related to existential concerns.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何在生活中寻找意义及其对态度和行为的影响，关注存在主义关切的相关假设。

faculty.name: Daniel Howard
faculty.summary: Studies health outcomes and disparities among African Americans, using health services and policy research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国人健康结果和差异，使用健康服务和政策研究方法。

faculty.name: Ian Hughes
faculty.summary: Studies the impacts of interpersonal exchanges on workers' well-being, including psychological, behavioral, emotional, and cognitive indicators.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际交流对员工福祉的影响，包括心理、行为、情绪和认知指标。

faculty.name: Heather Lench
faculty.summary: Studies how emotions influence future thinking and decision-making, examining when emotions improve functioning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪如何影响对未来思维和决策的作用，探讨情绪在何种情况下改善功能。

faculty.name: Israel Liberzon
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of trauma and stress-related disorders, focusing on brain regions involved in PTSD.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤和应激相关障碍的神经生物学，重点关注PTSD相关的脑区。

faculty.name: Annmarie MacNamara
faculty.summary: Studies emotional responses and cognitive factors in psychiatric disorders using neuroimaging and psychophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪反应和认知因素在精神疾病中的作用，使用神经成像和生理学方法。

faculty.name: Vani Mathur
faculty.summary: Studies the sources of disparities in pain, focusing on how social and cultural factors influence pain experience and physiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究疼痛差异的来源，重点关注社会和文化因素如何影响疼痛体验和生理学。

faculty.name: Allegra Midgette
faculty.summary: Studies how children and families develop moral and caring behaviors, focusing on justice within and outside the family.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和家庭如何发展道德和关怀行为，重点关注家庭内外的正义感。

faculty.name: Yumiko Mochinushi
faculty.summary: Studies industrial-organizational psychology, focusing on workplace behavior and performance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工业组织心理学，关注工作场所的行为和绩效。

faculty.name: Justin Moscarello
faculty.summary: Studies the neural pathways of learning and memory, focusing on how different types of memory compete to influence behavior, using active avoidance behavior as a model.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经通路，关注不同类型记忆如何竞争影响行为，使用主动回避行为作为模型。

faculty.name: Joseph Orr
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and neural mechanisms of executive functions, focusing on task-switching and voluntary task selection, using behavioral, computational, and neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究执行功能的心理学和神经机制，重点关注任务切换和自愿任务选择，使用行为、计算和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Stephanie C. Payne
faculty.summary: Studies how individual differences affect human resource practices and organizational safety initiatives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体差异如何影响人力资源实践和组织安全倡议。

faculty.name: Rebecca Schlegel
faculty.summary: Studies the true self, well-being, and meaning in life, exploring authenticity and self-integrity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究真正的自我、幸福感和生命意义，探讨真实性和自我完整性。

faculty.name: Brandon Schmeichel
faculty.summary: Studies self-control, emotion regulation, and working memory, exploring how these processes influence decision-making and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我控制、情绪调节和工作记忆，探讨这些过程如何影响决策和行为。

faculty.name: Rachel Smallman
faculty.summary: Studies how counterfactual thinking influences decision-making and categorization, integrating social and cognitive methodology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究反事实思维如何影响决策和分类过程，结合社会认知方法论。

faculty.name: Rachel Smith
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of drug addiction and relapse using animal models, focusing on compulsive behaviors and maladaptive habits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾和复燃的神经机制，使用动物模型探讨强迫行为和适应不良习惯。

faculty.name: Sebastian Speer
faculty.summary: Studies how minds become coupled during interactions, using fMRI hyperscanning and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究互动过程中人类和人工心智如何耦合，使用功能性磁共振成像超扫描和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Rongxiang Tang
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain supports higher-order cognitive functions like attention and memory in young and older adults, using neuroimaging and cognitive assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持注意力和记忆等高级认知功能，使用神经成像和认知评估方法，涵盖从年轻到老年各年龄段。

faculty.name: Zina Trost
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive, affective, and behavioral factors contributing to chronic pain and disability, using virtual reality interventions and examining perceptions of injustice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知、情感和行为因素对慢性疼痛和残疾的影响，使用虚拟现实干预措施并探讨不公正感知。

faculty.name: Jyotsna Vaid
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neurocognitive aspects of bilingualism, reading processes, and directional biases in spatial cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究双语认知和神经认知方面、阅读过程以及空间认知中的方向偏差。

faculty.name: Matthew Vess
faculty.summary: Studies how existential concerns like personal identity and meaning impact psychological processes, using social psychology methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究存在主义关切（如个人身份和意义）对心理过程的影响，采用社会心理学方法。

faculty.name: Andres Viana
faculty.summary: Studies anxiety disorders in youth and adults, focusing on cognitive-affective mechanisms and improving treatments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人焦虑障碍的认知-情感机制，并改进治疗方法。

faculty.name: Anka Vujanovic
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological mechanisms of posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and its co-occurring conditions, developing interventions for treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）及其共病条件的心理机制，并开发治疗方法。

faculty.name: Zak Witkower
faculty.summary: Studies nonverbal communication, particularly how body movements convey social rank, emotion, and personality, using advanced quantitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非言语交流，特别是身体动作如何传达社会地位、情绪和个性，并使用先进的定量方法。

faculty.name: Darrell Worthy
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes like learning and decision-making using behavioral methods, computational modeling, and fMRI, with a focus on individual differences and aging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程如学习和决策，使用行为方法、计算建模和fMRI，关注个体差异和老化。

faculty.name: Amanda J. Wright
faculty.summary: Studies how personality changes and develops across the lifespan, using various analytic methods and data sources.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格在一生中的变化和发展，使用多种分析方法和数据来源。

faculty.name: Takashi Yamauchi
faculty.summary: Studies how emotions and unconscious processing influence behavior, using computational models and mouse-tracking techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪和无意识处理如何影响行为，使用计算模型和鼠标追踪技术。

faculty.name: Mia Zhu
faculty.summary: Studies employee well-being and recovery from work stress using interventions like cognitive reappraisal and just-in-time adaptive interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究员工福祉和工作压力恢复，使用认知重评和即时适应性干预等方法。

faculty.name: Outreach Pro
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿通过社会线索学习单词的认知过程，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Spencer Behmer
faculty.summary: Studies the nutritional physiology and ecology of insects, including their dietary preferences and nutrient utilization.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究昆虫的营养生理生态，包括它们的饮食偏好和营养利用。

faculty.name: John Buchanan
faculty.summary: Studies motor neuroscience, focusing on motor control and learning in humans and animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动神经科学，专注于人类和动物的运动控制与学习。

faculty.name: Wei-Jung A. Chen
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of substance abuse on the developing brain, including polydrug interactions and fetal alcohol syndrome, using animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物质滥用对发育中大脑的影响，包括多药交互作用和胎儿酒精综合症，使用动物模型进行研究。

faculty.name: Yoonsuck Choe
faculty.summary: Studies brain networks and neural intelligence using computational models and simulations, focusing on mouse brain networks and cortical maps.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑网络和神经智能，使用计算模型和模拟，重点关注小鼠大脑网络和皮层图谱。

faculty.name: Scott Dindot
faculty.summary: Improves Vashisht College of Medicine website.
faculty.summary_zh: 改进瓦希什兽医学院网站。

faculty.name: Dustin Dubois
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of neuropsychopharmacological agents and their effects on brain development and aging, using electrophysiology and optogenetic techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经精神药理学剂的细胞和分子机制及其对大脑发育和衰老的影响，使用电生理学和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Daniel Hajovsky
faculty.summary: Studies educational and school psychology, focusing on interventions and support systems for students.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究教育和学校心理学，侧重于学生干预和支持系统的评估与设计。

faculty.name: Sharon Kerwin
faculty.summary: Studies spinal cord injury and clinical orthopedics in veterinary surgery.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究兽医脊髓损伤和临床骨科。

faculty.name: Stephen Maren
faculty.summary: Studies neural systems for emotion, learning, and memory, focusing on fear and anxiety in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪、学习和记忆的神经机制，特别是在啮齿动物中的恐惧和焦虑。

faculty.name: Christine Merlin
faculty.summary: Studies how monarch butterflies use circadian clocks for long-distance migration, focusing on gene function and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究 monarch 蝴蝶如何使用昼夜节律钟进行长距离迁徙，重点关注基因功能和行为机制。

faculty.name: MD Gerard Toussaint
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular biology of high-grade glioma in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类高级胶质瘤的分子生物学。
